sermon.title: What is the Gospel? 01/14/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer traces how scripture names the gospel—good news of Jesus Christ, of God, of the kingdom, of grace and of peace—and insists there is one everlasting gospel that cannot be added to. It is the power of God to salvation and reveals God’s righteousness. Two miracles stand above the gifts: salvation and becoming a new creature, as Peter and Paul show.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Kept as spoken: “John 3:17” (the quote is John 3:7–8); Peter “cursed God”; “millions [unclear] following Christ.” Point to check: Christianity in America “fallen from 80 some percent to 70 some percent” (35:30). Sensitive content kept as spoken: no rapture needed, the wicked judged on earth; Jesus appearing to Muslims in visions; professing-Christian politicians enslaving Africans and killing Native Americans; Andrew Jackson and the Trail of Tears; Protestants and Catholics persecuting each other.
